# Phillips

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c15 P73](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0073)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037)</sub>

## Personality

Mr. Phillips carries out his duties with a stern and sometimes high-handed discipline, resorting to public humiliation, corporal punishment, and assigning embarrassing seats. He exhibits clear favoritism toward his older scholars, spending significant class time giving special attention to Prissy Andrews under the guise of helping her with lessons. He also shows a lack of tact, openly labeling struggling students in front of the class.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c15 P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083), [v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089), [v1 c17 P38](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0038)_

## History

Mr. Phillips served as the schoolmaster at the Avonlea schoolhouse, where he taught scholars across various grade levels. During class, he frequently focused his personal attention on Prissy Andrews by giving her individual assistance in algebra and Latin in the back of the room. When Gilbert Blythe teased Anne Shirley by calling her 'Carrots' and pulling her braid, Anne retaliated by breaking her slate over Gilbert's head; Mr. Phillips punished Anne by making her stand in front of the blackboard with a message written above her head. The following day, after Anne arrived late alongside several other pupils, Mr. Phillips singled her out for punishment by ordering her to sit with Gilbert Blythe, leading Anne to leave school and refuse to return under his instruction for a time. Despite his criticized teaching methods and stern discipline, driven students like Anne and Gilbert were able to advance to the fifth class under his curriculum and prepare for higher studies.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c15 P36](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0036), [v1 c15 P70](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0070), [v1 c15 P73](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0073), [v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037), [v1 c17 P38](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0038)_
